title: CIA Raided Tulsi Gabbard's Office, Took 40 Boxes on JFK & MK Ultra - Whatfinger News Quick Hits
text:
MK-Ultra mastermind Allen W. Dulles oversaw covert CIA operations and was responsible for the expansion of the ultimately failed mind-control program of the 1950s. Photo courtesy Britannica
The CIA raided Tulsi Gabbard’s office and seized files on the JFK assassination and MKUltra, which the Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard was about to declassify. The president ordered these files to be released.
Read Full Article: https://www.independentsentinel.com/cia-raided-tulsi-gabbards-office-took-40-boxes-on-jfk-mk-ultra/
